Loyalty programme payout check: points redeemed by members cost us 19.4% of the revenue those members bring in (€177.8k redeemed vs €915k revenue) — a high "discount rate" for a rewards programme, with another €669k in issued-but-unredeemed points still owed.

Correcting an early red flag: loyalty members don't actually return items more than other customers once you compare like-for-like by product category — the earlier "members refund 2x more" number was mostly because members are concentrated in our highest-return category (apparel, ~38% refund rate for everyone there), not because membership itself drives returns.

Programme reach is small and uneven: only ~16% of customers are enrolled in loyalty (flat for 2 years), under 1% have ever used a referral code, and our B2B wholesale merchants have no loyalty programme at all.
